reviews.text: Every time I take my dogs there they do a good job at cutting their hair. The people there are really nice and they take care of my dogs.

"I've tried a few professional groomers, but honestly? One of Fudge's best haircuts was done by a student at San Diego Grooming Academy. I never met her personally, but the students here really give their all. The front desk staff are wonderful, the prices are incredible for what you get, and the owner is lovely — he came out personally to inspect Fudge and offer suggestions. Highly recommend!"
We love the picture! Thank you for the review.

Superb quality grooming and attentiveness to our dogs. They actually know your dog and their personality. We take 5 massive dogs here and they’ve always handled them with care and the dogs are relaxed. The exposure to being handled all over, groomed has been tremendous. We drive across San Diego County to come here. We’ve paid quite a bit more at other places with subpar results. So happy to be a part of this school.
My Einstein gets separation anxiety, but he's loved by the staff like his buddy Charlie!!
Great place to go to school, they have taught me so much, from bathing, to safety, to grooming, I highly recommend bringing your doggy in 😀 …

I just walked by and saw one of the groomers (blue grooming top- long black hair in a braid or ponytail ) extremely aggressively pull on the leash of a very small dog w only a collar on. I’d absolutely never leave my dog with these people.
Thank you for the review.

I have a beautiful doddle puppy she looked like a mop! No mats just lots of long curls. I took her here and they shaved all of her curls away. She was there for over 6 hours. I want to cry. I said I didn't want them to do much just show me her eyes. So Angry.

Whoever groomed, my dog, it was the best room I’ve ever had on any animal I’ve ever owned. We are here. It’s even making me think about going to school and becoming a groomer myself if they can teach you to groom like a pro right out of school with a plus.
Lori
Lola mom
It works great for our doodle. It takes a bit longer than a standard groomer, but the students are doing a fantastic job. I'm a customer for almost 2 yrs
Great place to get your puppys hsir cut done
My go-to for my puppies' grooming needs. Always great cuts, communication and service
We love bringing our pup here! Everyone is friendly and professional. Our dog always comes back to us happy, clean and well groomed
Can’t say enough how grateful I am for this buisness for all the work and the love they give to our children (pets😂). Thank you so much and definitely recommend them 🙏 …

I called to get basic information on how long the course is , I work Monday thru Friday 10-6pm so didn’t want to miss out on a day of work to get one question answered which was how many weeks/months(hours) the program is . They said they couldn’t tell me anything at all , i left the phone call with no information at all and being forced to loose a day of work for something that can be a minute phone call doesn’t seem right there’s also no info on their website . If the weeks worked for me I would have definitely scheduled the tour since i would have know it’s a course I could accomplish.
Thank you for the review.
Thank you for the five-star review. We appreciate your business.
Love love love San Diego Grooming Academy. They take amazing care of my two doodles. Love the weekly bathing program and student groomers save me tons of money. Great customer service too.
I bring all 3 of my dogs here (Afghan Hound, poodle mix and terrier mix and they do an awesome job with all three every time!
Thank you so much!
Thank you!

This is the ONLY place in San Diego that I can take my very nervous dog. They do such a great job at calming her, reading her cues, keeping her and the staff safe, and their grooming skills are great too.
Best grooming and bathing out there!
Thank you for the five-stars review. Such a sweet photo to share. We look forward to seeing you again soon.
